scope: Bounded architecture, compiler, response, and distributed-systems review; not an exhaustive catalog.

rows.source_claim: Attention encoder-decoder with autoregressive output.
rows.evidence: WMT14 translation; eight P100 GPUs, 3.5 days for the large model.
rows.transferable_pattern: Treat connectivity and generation procedure separately.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Parallel teacher-forced training is not parallel generation.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Matched-checkpoint prefill/decode and exact-output tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Reported throughput fails to reproduce under the actual batch and precision.

source.label: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

rows.source_claim: Bidirectional masked-language encoder with downstream adaptation.
rows.evidence: Eleven NLP tasks; task-specific fine-tuning.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Encoder outputs are not automatically calibrated retrieval embeddings or a chat planner.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Retrieval/classification holdout with calibrated acceptance.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Semantic retrieval or OOD errors exceed the incumbent.

rows.source_claim: Large causal language model performs tasks from examples in context.
rows.evidence: 175B parameters and 300B training tokens; broad language benchmark evaluation.
rows.assumption_mismatch: In-context adaptation is not weight learning; benchmark contamination and calibration matter.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Freeze model, prompt, task lineage and exact response contracts.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Apparent learning disappears under source-family holdout.

rows.source_claim: Sparse feed-forward expert selection inside a Transformer.
rows.evidence: Two of eight experts per token; about 47B total and 13B active parameters.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Active parameters exclude resident memory and routing/communication overhead; experts are not governed agents.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Compare total memory, latency and verified quality at actual concurrency.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Active-parameter saving does not reduce end-to-end cost.

source.label: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness

rows.source_claim: Tiled exact attention reduces high-bandwidth-memory traffic.
rows.evidence: Hardware- and workload-specific attention/training comparisons.
rows.assumption_mismatch: It does not turn dense attention arithmetic into linear complexity.
rows.repository_mapping: model provider adapter; usage accounting; context manifests
rows.proposed_experiment: Pin hardware, precision, sequence length and checkpoint.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Kernel speedup does not improve the product latency or budget.

source.label: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

rows.source_claim: Paged KV allocation reduces serving memory waste and enables sharing.
rows.evidence: Historical A100 trace workloads and reconstructed comparison systems.
rows.transferable_pattern: Provider-serving capability rather than semantic memory.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Throughput under load is not single-request latency; prompt-cache isolation remains separate.
rows.repository_mapping: model provider adapter; usage accounting; context manifests
rows.proposed_experiment: Compare throughput and p95 latency with namespace/caching tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: More throughput causes unacceptable tail latency or contamination.

source.label: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

rows.source_claim: Input-dependent state-space recurrence supports efficient sequence processing.
rows.evidence: Language and other sequence tasks; throughput depends on batch and hardware.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Long input length is not proof of retained exact facts; one efficiency model was untrained.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Rare identifiers, negation, ordering, restart and state-isolation tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Compression loses contract-critical information.

source.label: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model

rows.source_claim: Combines attention, Mamba, and sparse experts.
rows.evidence: About 52B total/12B active; long-context and hardware-dependent comparisons.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Neural hybrid differs from Loop hybrid mode; precision and hardware confound comparisons.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_demand.py; model capability catalog; context contracts
rows.proposed_experiment: Match actual hardware/precision and test long-context task loss.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Savings vanish or exact dependency retrieval regresses.

rows.source_claim: Learns a reverse denoising process for generation.
rows.evidence: Image quality evaluation with iterative sampling, including a 1000-step schedule.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Image metrics do not establish instruction correctness; denoising steps cost compute.
rows.proposed_experiment: Measure end-to-end generation and independent artifact verification.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Fewer steps reduce cost but violate required quality.

rows.source_claim: Masked diffusion language generation with a non-causal Transformer.
rows.evidence: 8B model, 2.3T tokens, supervised tuning and language benchmarks.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Largest causal comparison is not fully training-matched; agent/tool integration unproven.
rows.proposed_experiment: Replay identical semantic contracts and count steps, tokens, latency, repairs.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Schema/task reliability or total cost loses to the incumbent.

rows.source_claim: Regresses vector fields along probability paths without simulating the full training trajectory.
rows.evidence: Image generation with diffusion and transport-related paths.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Sampling still solves dynamics; conditional transport is not a universal global-optimality claim.
rows.proposed_experiment: Matched-quality compute comparison including numerical integration.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Function-evaluation reduction does not reduce physical cost.

source.label: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models

rows.source_claim: DreamerV3 learns latent dynamics and behavior through imagined trajectories.
rows.evidence: More than 150 tasks with shared hyperparameters and task-specific training.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Shared settings do not mean one trained universal agent; learned dynamics can be wrong.
rows.repository_mapping: Practitioner candidate planning; speculative state; verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Counterfactual/environment-shift tests with real outcome verification.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Imagined reward increases while actual outcomes deteriorate.

source.label: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model

rows.source_claim: MuZero learns planning-relevant latent dynamics and uses tree search.
rows.evidence: 57 Atari games and three board-game domains; substantial self-play/search compute.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Root legality and environment assumptions remain; search can amplify model bias.
rows.repository_mapping: Practitioner candidate planning; speculative state; verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Include illegal/stale actions and charge training/search/evaluation.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Simulated success cannot survive independent environment checks.

source.label: Solving olympiad geometry without human demonstrations

rows.source_claim: Learned geometric proposals combined with symbolic deduction.
rows.evidence: 25 of 30 translated geometry problems in the studied subset.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Restricted formalization excludes important problem classes; synthetic-data generation is expensive.
rows.proposed_experiment: Measure translation correctness separately from proof checking.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A verified proof establishes the wrong formalized task.

source.label: An LLM Compiler for Parallel Function Calling

rows.source_claim: Tool descriptions and argument dependencies guide parallel execution plans.
rows.evidence: Historical HotpotQA parallel subset and movie tasks; latency gains depend on available parallelism.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Data independence does not establish effect commutativity or source freshness.
rows.proposed_experiment: Full-source versus contract-card planning with conflicting effects.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Parallel composition duplicates effects or returns stale results.

source.label: Program Synthesis from Polymorphic Refinement Types

rows.source_claim: Refinement types constrain synthesis in a restricted logic.
rows.evidence: 64 functional synthesis problems.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Decidable refinement assumptions do not cover arbitrary tools or side effects.
rows.proposed_experiment: Same ordinary types with different semantic refinements.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Type-correct composition violates a required postcondition.

rows.source_claim: TYGAR refines abstractions to search typed component compositions.
rows.evidence: 291 Haskell components, 44 queries; 43 typed results within 60 seconds and 32 useful top-five results in inspected text.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Well-typed does not imply useful; reported abstract/body counts differ.
rows.proposed_experiment: Measure semantic usefulness after type admission.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Typed success overstates independently verified usefulness.

rows.source_claim: Generate programs and delegate calculations to an interpreter.
rows.evidence: 13 mathematical and symbolic tasks.
rows.transferable_pattern: Separate semantic formalization from mechanical computation.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Wrong formalization remains possible; some headline comparisons use different models.
rows.proposed_experiment: Hidden unit/edge-case tests for emitted programs.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Correct execution produces the wrong task answer.

source.label: Program of Thoughts Prompting: Disentangling Computation from Reasoning for Numerical Reasoning Tasks

rows.source_claim: Programmed calculations support numerical reasoning.
rows.evidence: Five math and three finance datasets; some variants include final model synthesis.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Charge every stage; roots, units, and interpretation can remain ambiguous.
rows.proposed_experiment: Equivalent formulations and multi-root counterexamples.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Mechanical calculation hides a semantic selection error.

rows.source_claim: Distills task knowledge into reusable clingo theories.
rows.evidence: 100 training and 200 validation examples, three seeds, bounded search; symbolic inputs.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Ground-truth symbolic scenes/questions bypass perception; brave entailment can admit multiple answers.
rows.proposed_experiment: Require unique correct entailment and audit input formalization.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: The solver includes a correct answer among incorrect alternatives.

source.label: PICARD: Parsing Incrementally for Constrained Auto-Regressive Decoding from Language Models

rows.source_claim: Incremental parsing and scope checks constrain text-to-SQL output.
rows.evidence: T5-3B SQL experiments report fewer unusable queries.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Syntax and scope do not establish intended joins or answer correctness.
rows.proposed_experiment: Execute on multiple databases and adversarial schemas.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A valid query returns a coincidentally correct result on one database.

rows.source_claim: Separates schema coverage, efficiency and output quality.
rows.evidence: 10,000 real-world schemas and six structured-generation systems.
rows.transferable_pattern: Versioned schema-subset handshake and conformance corpus.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Different models/system versions confound direct comparisons.
rows.proposed_experiment: Count invalid outputs accepted and valid outputs excluded.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Advertised schema support is not observed at runtime.

rows.source_claim: Examines distribution distortion from constrained decoding and proposes approximate correction.
rows.evidence: Finite-sample approximation studies with mixed task outcomes and convergence cost.
rows.transferable_pattern: Treat decoding policy as an experiment variable.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Finite approximation is not an exact guarantee or universal accuracy improvement.
rows.proposed_experiment: Matched semantic loss, sample count and decoder cost.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Validity improves while downstream correctness falls.

rows.source_claim: Response format restrictions affect tasks differently.
rows.evidence: Format/task comparisons with limited schema complexity and imperfect answer extraction.
rows.transferable_pattern: Negotiable payload inside a stable protocol envelope.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Does not justify removing effect or authority fields.
rows.proposed_experiment: Minimal versus fixed versus negotiated formats.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Schema overhead excludes valid answers or increases repair cost.

rows.source_claim: Compresses APIs/examples with question-type adaptation for visual question answering.
rows.evidence: Reports substantial input reduction in a bounded VQA system.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Classifier errors, extra calls and narrow task assumptions matter.
rows.proposed_experiment: Full-source versus compressed cards with total-cost accounting.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Compression harms rare API behavior or loses economic benefit.

source.label: LLMLingua: Compressing Prompts for Accelerated Inference of Large Language Models

rows.source_claim: Small-model token selection reduces supplied prompt text.
rows.evidence: Four datasets with task- and compression-dependent tradeoffs.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Predictability is not task sufficiency; aggressive compression can break code or exact constraints.
rows.proposed_experiment: Negation, exact keys, units and causal-history holdouts.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Shorter prompts increase downstream loss or repair.

rows.source_claim: Describes properties, actions, events, schemas and security mechanisms.
rows.evidence: Normative interoperability vocabulary, not a Loop Engine deployment result.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Descriptions do not grant authority or secure an insecure endpoint.
rows.proposed_experiment: Schema/units/security/version and unknown-extension tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Descriptive metadata is treated as permission or verified behavior.

rows.source_claim: Explicit imports and exports define a component interaction surface.
rows.evidence: Component-model documentation, not a behavior-proof theorem.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Typed interfaces do not prove behavior or host isolation.
rows.proposed_experiment: Missing import, resource ownership and effect-isolation tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A component escapes declared effects or lacks needed semantics.

rows.source_claim: Workload identity documents and trust-domain verification.
rows.evidence: X.509/JWT identity concepts; workload isolation is assumed.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Authentication is distinct from authorization; token replay and trust rotation matter.
rows.proposed_experiment: Revocation, replay, cross-domain and credential-isolation tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Valid identity grants an unauthorized effect.

rows.source_claim: Publish/subscribe transport with multiple delivery guarantees.
rows.evidence: Normative protocol and session behavior.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Message delivery is not verified exactly-once physical actuation.
rows.proposed_experiment: Duplicate, reconnect, stale retained event and crash-window tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A retry duplicates an effect or uses expired state.

rows.source_claim: Common event context, identity and payload metadata.
rows.evidence: Normative source/id uniqueness and event representation.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Does not supply authority, semantic validity or exactly-once effects.
rows.proposed_experiment: Duplicate identity, schema mismatch and namespace isolation.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Duplicate transport event creates a second committed action.

rows.source_claim: Deployment restrictions reduce container and cluster exposure.
rows.evidence: Official operational guidance, not product assurance.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Container presence alone is not full isolation or hard real-time control.
rows.proposed_experiment: Mount, privilege, network, resource and timeout escape tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A worker accesses another task or outlives its owned budget.

rows.source_claim: Documents schema enforcement and states Cloud currently lacks structured outputs.
rows.evidence: Official capability statement; actual configured provider needs independent probing.
rows.transferable_pattern: Separate JSON emission from provider-enforced schema support.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Local Ollama examples cannot prove Cloud support.
rows.repository_mapping: core/model_gateway.py; model response admission; model capability catalog
rows.proposed_experiment: Exact route/schema canary and response-admission tests.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: A Boolean capability claim silently assumes unsupported enforcement.

source.label: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models

rows.source_claim: Samples and aggregates multiple candidate answers.
rows.evidence: Forty samples per question in main setup; four model families and multiple arithmetic/commonsense tasks; primary comparison is one greedy output.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Inference cost is not matched; stochastic samples do not imply independent errors.
rows.repository_mapping: canonical Loop delegation, candidate comparison, model demand and independent verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Compare 1/3/5 samples with one stronger model at matched actual cost.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Shared wrong answers or no marginal verified utility after full cost.

source.label: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate

rows.source_claim: Peers revise candidate answers after exchange.
rows.evidence: Usually three agents/two rounds; 100-case math/knowledge sets, 300 chess games, 524 biography subjects; biography evaluator can miss unsupported extra false claims.
rows.transferable_pattern: Compare independent sampling with peer critique.
rows.assumption_mismatch: More rounds cost more; heterogeneous graders and incomplete factual coverage limit claims.
rows.repository_mapping: canonical Loop delegation, candidate comparison, model demand and independent verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Preserve initial candidates and count corrections versus corruptions under budget control.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Debate advantage disappears against equal-cost sampling or harms exact correctness.

source.label: Talk Isn't Always Cheap: Understanding Failure Modes in Multi-Agent Debate

rows.source_claim: Peer exchange can turn initially correct answers into wrong consensus.
rows.evidence: Three task sets with 100 sampled questions each, five seeds, several model strengths and two rounds.
rows.transferable_pattern: Retain dissent and test harmful revisions.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Repeated seeds do not imply new independent tasks; conformity is not uniquely established as the cause.
rows.repository_mapping: canonical Loop delegation, candidate comparison, model demand and independent verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Randomize peer order and inject persuasive incorrect critique; independent outcome checks.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Harmful flips exceed corrections despite increased agreement.

source.label: Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems on Multi-Hop Reasoning Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets

rows.source_claim: Simpler agents win many studied multi-hop comparisons after requested thinking-budget controls.
rows.evidence: FRAMES and MuSiQue 4-hop; multiple model families, six requested caps, five multi-agent patterns; model-judge scoring.
rows.transferable_pattern: Charge coordination and compare equal evidence access.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Requested caps are not measured equal compute; approximate provider accounting; ideal-predictor information arguments do not prove finite-LLM dominance.
rows.repository_mapping: canonical Loop delegation, candidate comparison, model demand and independent verification
rows.proposed_experiment: Measure complete input/output/call/latency cost and independent task quality.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Complementary specialists retain verified gains after fair accounting; otherwise narrow the panel policy.

source.label: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Extended Version)

rows.source_claim: Raft agrees on an ordered log for deterministic replicated state machines.
rows.evidence: Algorithm, safety argument, implementation and understandability study; non-Byzantine/crash fault assumptions.
rows.transferable_pattern: Consistent committed history, not semantic truth voting.
rows.assumption_mismatch: Requires log/term/election rules and stable state; a quorum does not validate task facts.
rows.repository_mapping: Run History and any future replicated-store adapter; not LLM answer voting
rows.proposed_experiment: Inject delay, reorder, loss and one crash; separately reject consistently replicated wrong task candidates.
rows.failure_and_falsifier: Committed state divergence or semantic acceptance based only on quorum.
